name: Henry P. Hernandez
office: La Puente Valley County Water District, Member, Board of Directors

items.text: Vice President Henry P. Hernandez has served on the La Puente Valley County Water District Board of Directors since 2009. He previously served on the city's Planning Commission and Redevelopment Board. He says he is a retired Department of Defense quality assurance worker who supervised water desalination contractors. In 2023, the board returned to a Stage 1 Water Supply Emergency and began testing a new groundwater treatment facility.
